# Crickrida — Cricket via Stats
> Free IPL and T20 World Cup analytics built on ball-by-ball data (IPL 2008–2026, T20 World Cup 2007–2026). No account needed.

Crickrida (https://crickrida.rkjat.in) is an open analytics platform for the Indian Premier League (IPL). It provides historical match data, player statistics, team performance, venue analysis, trending insights and a free studio for creating shareable stat cards.

## What Crickrida covers

- **IPL seasons**: Complete data for all IPL seasons from 2008 to 2026.
- **Match archive**: Ball-by-ball records for every IPL match, with innings breakdowns and match results.
- **Batting records**: Career and season-level batting statistics — runs, strike rate, average, boundaries, centuries, half-centuries — for all IPL batters.
- **Bowling records**: Career and season-level bowling statistics — wickets, economy rate, bowling average, dot-ball %, best figures — for all IPL bowlers.
- **Team profiles**: Full franchise history, win/loss records, points tables, and season-by-season performance for all 10 active IPL teams.
- **Venue analytics**: Ground-specific stats including average first-innings score, chase success rate, and venue win-loss history.
- **Head-to-head comparisons**: Historical rivalry records between any two IPL teams, and player-vs-player comparisons.
- **Charts & insights**: Phase-wise run rates (Powerplay, Middle, Death), dismissal type breakdowns, toss impact analysis, cap winners, and batting/bowling performance matrices.
- **Cricket Pulse**: Trending insights discovered from the data — milestones, streaks, records about to fall — plus "On This Day" in IPL history.
- **Studio**: Free tool to turn any stat into a branded card for X/Twitter, Instagram, LinkedIn or stories.
- **FAQ**: Answers to the most commonly asked questions about IPL history, rules, format, auctions, records, and players — structured as Q&A for quick answer-engine retrieval.

## Key facts (as of June 2026)

- Dataset spans 2008–2026 (17+ IPL seasons).
- Covers all franchise editions including Chennai Super Kings, Mumbai Indians, Royal Challengers Bengaluru, Kolkata Knight Riders, Sunrisers Hyderabad, Rajasthan Royals, Delhi Capitals, Punjab Kings, Lucknow Super Giants, and Gujarat Titans.
- All statistics are sourced from official IPL match data.

## Site structure

- /dashboard — Season overview, KPIs, leaderboards, and trend charts (default landing page)
- /matches — Full match archive with filters by season and team
- /batting — All-time and season batting leaderboards
- /bowling — All-time and season bowling leaderboards
- /teams — Franchise performance hub
- /venues — Ground-by-ground analytics
- /seasons — Year-by-year IPL season records
- /h2h — Head-to-head team and player comparisons
- /charts — Statistical breakdowns and trend visualizations
- /pulse — Trending insights, streaks and On This Day
- /content-studio — Free stat-card studio (player, match, comparison, season, Top 5 cards)
- /fantasy — Fantasy picks: projected points, suggested XI, captain and vice-captain
- /quiz — "Guess the player" stats quiz
- /batting/compare, /bowling/compare — Compare players side by side
- /faq — Frequently asked questions about the IPL (history, rules, format, auctions, records, players)
